title: Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO, probes continue
since_label: Fri 6 Nov close, the last price before the weekend reports
status: Bloomberg, cited by Seeking Alpha and The Next Web, reports Nvidia Blackwell racks appeared in Chinese loan filings for a Shanghai data center linked to Megaspeed's founder, and it says it is unclear whether those shipments had US approval; Yahoo Finance reports Nvidia flipped from a 2% gain at Friday's open to a 2% loss, and Forbes reports Trump again said Huang poses no security risk. Huang still faces a closed-door House interview on 1 Dec and a Senate Banking hearing on 3 Dec, and MS NOW reports the commerce secretary has agreed to testify to Senate Banking, though no date is set.
why: Nvidia is the anchor of the AI trade and one of the heaviest weights in the Nasdaq, which alts follow.
next_label: House closed-door interview with Huang, Teter 2 Dec, Senate hearing 3 Dec
sources: Bloomberg, Seeking Alpha, The Next Web, Yahoo Finance, Forbes, MS NOW, CNBC, Politico

title: MSCI drops Strategy from its indexes
since_label: Wed 11 Nov close, before MSCI's after-hours announcement
status: Yahoo Finance shows Strategy up 2.7% on Fri 27 Nov, and Rolling Out reports the stock is still down about 39% for November after a 52-week low near $70 on 25 Nov; Coinbase shows bitcoin near $61,500, still about 18% below Strategy's average cost of $75,446. MSCI's deletion takes effect after Monday's 30 Nov close, and the Motley Fool says MSCI's screen gives other index providers a template, though none has yet said it will follow.
why: Strategy is the largest corporate BTC holder, and forced selling of its shares tests the main route equity money takes into bitcoin.
sources: MSCI, Strategy, Yahoo Finance, Rolling Out, Motley Fool, Coinbase, Decrypt, CoinDesk

title: US proposes new tariffs on China, EU and 12 others
since_label: Tue 24 Nov 13:00 UTC, before the WSJ tariff report
status: China's Commerce Ministry said on Thu 26 Nov that it firmly opposes the Section 301 proposal and reserves the right to take necessary measures (reported by Xinhua and by Bloomberg via Business Standard), and Bloomberg says Washington is holding a 40% China tariff threat in reserve. Written comments are due on 5 Jan 2027 and hearings start on 25 Jan, the AP reports the US-China truce expires on 10 Jan, and Yahoo Finance reports the Nasdaq rebounded on Friday.
why: Tariffs on China and the EU hit chip and AI hardware supply chains and feed inflation and Fed hike odds, which weigh on the Nasdaq and crypto together.
next_label: Comments due; US-China truce expires 10 Jan, hearings from 25 Jan
sources: USTR, CNBC, Xinhua, Bloomberg, Business Standard, AP, Boston Globe, Yahoo Finance

title: Iran and US trade strikes in the Gulf
since_label: Thu 12 Nov 00:00 UTC, before Iran reported the Sirik strike
status: CBS News and ABC News report Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed on Thu 26 Nov that two more tankers hit mines north of Khasab, and Kuwait says an Iranian drone attack killed two Italians; CBS reports Trump has called Iran's mine claims lies meant to push up energy prices, and Yahoo News notes the claims could not be independently verified. No ceasefire has been announced, and the US naval blockade of Iranian ports stays in place.
why: CoinDesk cites the Gulf escalation, with the dollar and Fed hike odds, behind the crypto sell-off; oil feeds straight into rate expectations.
sources: Reuters, CBS News, ABC News, Yahoo News, CNBC, Times of Israel, CoinDesk

title: Anthropic IPO, the largest AI listing
since_label: Tue 10 Nov, when the price range was set
status: Seeking Alpha reports ANT rose about 9% to $90.06 on Fri 27 Nov, back above its $83 IPO price, and notes Morningstar's fair value estimate of $92; KuCoin News reports the stock is still about 23% below its debut-day high of $115.10. TipRanks reports 15.5 billion pre-IPO shares are under lock-ups across 23 release dates, with founder stakes restricted until spring 2027, and the timing of Nasdaq 100 inclusion is still open.
why: A raise this size absorbs cash that would otherwise chase other risk, and its first-day close reprices every AI name.
sources: Seeking Alpha, TipRanks, TradingView, KuCoin News, Yahoo Finance, Investing.com, CNBC
